shotgun.m4.d: A semi automatic military issue shotgun

mace.d: Costing a negligible amount more than the machete, the mace offers far greater damage per swing at the cost of far less damage per second.

snowballgun.d: Load snowballs and lay waste to your foes with Christmas cheer.

weapon.mod.8x.scope.d: The 16x Zoom Scope is a military-grade telescopic sight.

paper.d: Paper used to be an ingredient to make notes, now only wood is required and paper has been since forgotten, maybe it will come back in the future to be used in other crafting.

water.salt.d: Salt water is similar to normal water, but it does more harm than good and is gathered from the sea.

targeting.computer.d: Used for crafting auto turrets, or recycling a large amounts of scrap.

water.d: Water can be used to regain thirst, heal yourself and remove radiation poisoning.

skull.wolf.d: The wolf skull allows players to craft the wolf headdress.

wood.d: Wood is possibly the most basic resource in the game.

barrelcostume.d: A stupid barrel costume, so you can hide like a pro..p

hazmatsuit_scientist_arctic.d: An Arctic Scientist Suit worn by the scientists which are found in arctic research bases.

hazmatsuit.arcticsuit.d: An arctic variant of the hazmat suit which trades radiation for cold protection.

mask.bandana.d: Cheap facial attire compatible with most head slots that wouldn't otherwise obscure it.

attire.banditguard.d: A Bandit Guard Suit worn by the guards at bandit camp.

hat.cap.d: Equivalent stats to beenie hat while costing less and requiring the steam item.

horse.shoes.basic.d: Equipping these horse shoes will grant your horse additional movement speed

hat.beenie.d: Equivalent stats to baseball cap while being more expensive and requiring research to create.

deer.skull.mask.d: Second only to the wolf headdress in primitive headwear, the bone helmet is a welcome sink for bone frags until metal can take its place.

hat.boonie.d: Equivalent stats and cost to burlap headwrap, but can be combined with the bandana.

shoes.boots.d: The limited available clothing slots often force a player to choose between boots, gloves, and bandanas, with the superior stats of the boots usually giving it priority.

bucket.helmet.d: A mid-tier helmet that protects the user's head.

attire.bunnyears.d: Bunny Ears. Grants additional Egg Vision allowing you to detect more eggs during an Easter egg hunt.

hat.bunnyhat.d: A silly Bunny Hat with wobbly ears to celebrate Easter 2021

attire.bunny.onesie.d: A Bunny Onesie. Grants additional Egg Vision allowing you to detect more eggs during an Easter egg hunt.

burlap.gloves.new.d: The Burlap gloves are the first of the 3 gloves as they are the only ones that can be crafted right when you start.

burlap.headwrap.d: As a default blueprint, the burlap headwrap is occasionally crafted during early-game after the hunting bow and bandages.

burlap.shirt.d: While its resistances are far from fantastic, this cheap mess of cloth may give a player the edge they need as they struggle to establish themselves.

burlap.shoes.d: Burlap shoes are a peice of clothing that goes on the feet, Burlap shoes also are the quietest, making footsteps harder to hear.

burlap.trousers.d: About as basic as it gets.

hat.candle.d: The candle hat may not have the best protection by itself, but it can be used in conjunction with the bandana to great effect.

clatter.helmet.d: A special item for those who own Clatter.

diving.mask.d: A Diving Mask. Provides clear vision under water.

diving.tank.d: The Diving Tank is a tank of air used for staying underwater for extended periods of time, 10 minutes to be exact.

horse.saddle.double.d: A horse saddle with two seats.

draculacape.d: A robustly thick outer garment providing ample protection to the wearer.

draculamask.d: A classic halloween costume mask which provides decent protection.

hat.dragonmask.d: A special dragon mask to celebrate Chinese New Year.

attire.egg.suit.d: An eggsquisite egg costume, can be painted when unequipped.

frankensteinmask.d: Frankenstein halloween costume mask which provides decent protection.

boots.frog.d: Added for anyone who owned the game while it was in Early Access.

ghostsheet.d: Definitely not a last minute costume idea.

gingerbreadsuit.d: A suit made of gingerbread, slightly crunchy.

gloweyes.d: Lighting effect used for the Halloween 2017 Murderer NPCs.

hazmatsuit.d: The Hazmat Suit allows the wearer to travel through rad-towns and other irradiated areas safely.

heavy.plate.helmet.d: A high-tier protective helmet which protects the entire head.

heavy.plate.jacket.d: A high-tier protective item that will protect the user from a large portion of the damage dealt by most sources at the price of a movement penalty.

heavy.plate.pants.d: An high-tier protective item that will protect the user from a large portion of the damage dealt by most sources at the price of a movement penalty.

scientistsuit_heavy.d: A Heavy Scientist Suit worn by the heavy scientists which are spawned at the oil rigs.

horse.shoes.advanced.d: Equipping these horse shoes will grant your horse additional movement speed

horse.saddle.d: Having this item allows you to claim a horse in a stable by holding E and selecting the 'Claim' option

hab.armor.d: Armor for the Hot Air Balloon

mask.balaclava.d: Essentially acting as an upgrade to the burlap headwrap, the balaclava's most distinguished aspect is its ability to resist cold.
